newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Banks to bid on HK$7-8 bln Shui Wing project loan.
newsitem.headline: Banks to bid on HK$7-8 bln Shui Wing project loan.

text.p: Banks are to be invited to bid this week for a mandate to arrange a HK$7-8 billion financing for a joint project by Swire Pacific Ltd's Swire Properties Ltd and Sun Hung Kai Properties Ltd's New Town (N.T) Properties Ltd, bankers said on Wednesday.
Bankers said they expected the four-year loan to be launched this week for the initial funding of the redevelopment of the former Shui Wing steel mill in Hong Kong's Tseung Kwan O.
Swire Pacific said in April that its wholly owned Swire Properties and Sun Hung Kai Properties' New Town (N.T.) Properties had acquired the rights to develop the site.
Swire Properties and New Town have formed an equally owned joint venture company to acquire the development rights.
The total project cost is estimated to be in excess of HK$25 billion, spread over a five-year development programme.
The Tseung Kwan O site has a development potential of about four million square feet of residential space.
Swire Pacific said last month that the joint venture planned to build more than 4,000 residential units, neighbourhood shopping space and ancillary carpark spaces.
